title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in rural Damascus is implemented by Trócaire and aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include cash / in-kind assistance to households in Rural Damascus based on comprehensive assessments so the most vulnerable are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, of high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with, Caritas Syria, St. Ephrem Patriarchal Development Committee (EPDC) and a new partner to-be-determined. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
